args.summary:
Model built and verified successfully (all L1/L2/L3 checks passed).

Bridge: cast-in-place continuous prestressed concrete single-cell box girder, 3 spans 30+45+30 m (bearing centre-lines), deck width 12.5 m, JTG D60-2015 Highway Class I, one-way, 3 design lanes.

Idealization: 2D spine beam, continuous_on_piers (MR-05, pier columns modelled). Girder modelled as one cast_box (A=7.05 m², I=4.7775 m⁴, self-weight-only section), C55 concrete → Ec=35500 MPa; γ=26 kN/m³ → w=183.3 kN/m, m=18.685 t/m.

Supports (2 bearings each, parallel stiffness summed): abutments 0 & 3 = PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric (400×500, 5×11 mm; S=10.10, Kv=3.614e6 kN/m, Kh=0 free); pier 1 = plain elastomeric fixed (600×700, 7×11 mm; S=14.69, Kv=8.974e6 kN/m, Kh=13090.9 kN/m); pier 2 = PTFE sliding (550×650, 6×11 mm; S=13.54, Kv=8.075e6 kN/m, Kh=0). All Ge=1.2 MPa (manufacturer value, per MR-00).

Piers: twin C40 circular columns D=1.4 m, A=3.079 m², I=0.3771 m⁴, Ec=32500 MPa; Pier 1 length 6 m, Pier 2 length 29 m, fixed at base.

Live load: qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk = 320/350/320 kN for spans 1/2/3, transverse lane factor ξ=0.78 (3 lanes).

Key results: f1 (vertical bending) = 3.239 Hz → impact factor μ = 0.192. Self-weight support reactions ≈ 1811/7843/7735/1858 kN (abutment 0, pier 1, pier 2, abutment 3). Self-weight mid-span moments ≈ 6546/18945/7244 kN·m; support moments ≈ −28150/−26755 kN·m. Lane-load max positive moment 11254 kN·m (span 2), max negative moment −8975 kN·m (support 1).
